blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Only two out of 315 government agencies have received their 2024 Performance-Based Bonus (PBB) funding, according to the Department of Budget and Management (DBM). Based on its online tracker released on Nov. 6, the DBM has released the Special Allotment Release Order (SARO) on Oct. 29 for Central Luzon State University amounting to P24.39 million, and for Nueva Ecija University of Science and Technology worth P1.146 million. It is now up to the two state universities to process the payment of PBB to their eligible officials and employees. Eighty-two percent of the agencies, or 258, are still “for […]...
